    Calculate BWM Weights

    calculate_bwm_weights.Rd

    Calculates criteria weights using the Best-Worst Method (BWM) via Linear Programming.

    calculate_bwm_weights(criteria_names, best_to_others, others_to_worst)

    Arguments

    criteria_names

    Character vector of criteria names.

    best_to_others

    Numeric vector (1-9). Preference of Best criterion over others.

    others_to_worst

    Numeric vector (1-9). Preference of others over Worst criterion.

    Value

    A list containing `criteria_weights`, `consistency_ratio`, and metadata.
